summary_markdown: The discussion focused on implementing a temporary solution to allow users to force reports or charts to refresh by bypassing the cache. Initially, [p1] questioned if this required manually adding the query parameter (qc) to all request payloads across dashboards and campaigns. [me] clarified that the requirement is for users who need to view specific reports or charts without cached data to be able to add `qc=0` directly into the URL. This method was deemed functional for now, with a plan to improve the implementation later.
decisions: Users can force cache bypass by adding `qc=0` to the report/chart URL.
action_items: Implement the temporary cache bypass mechanism using `qc=0` in the URL.
